limitations: Public robot grasp reference displacement is not cloth displacement, anatomical distance, or sleeve passage.
Neutral command is not zero physics or a fixed robot; intercepted stop has zero transitions.
Pose/RGB similarity across replay does not establish exact hidden physics or identical future response.
No hidden garment/human state, evaluator, raw model traces, or mutable HDF5 was used.
Historical user phase intentions are preserved; camera identity is not anatomical hand identity.
